name: doc-style frontmatter name
does: Declares the skill name
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: only the description is preloaded in the skill listing

name: doc-style trigger description
does: Read BEFORE writing comments or doc prose, and run as a rewrite pass before reporting done
preventsClaim: the skill is not invoked when prose is written
costNote: always in the skill listing of every agent that has the skill

name: Write for a cold maintainer
does: Assume the reader has not seen the module, design doc, or conversation
preventsClaim: prose that only makes sense to the author of the change

name: mise artifacts out of style scope
does: No style pass edits .mise/ workflow artifacts
preventsClaim: the mise state engine hashes them, so an edit breaks state

name: User-facing strings out of style scope
does: UI and WhatsApp copy follows spanish-voice.md; a rewrite pass never edits them
preventsClaim: a style pass rewrites approved customer copy

name: Everywhere heading
does: Heading only
preventsClaim: unstated

name: doc-style 1 one idea per sentence
does: State it once, stop
preventsClaim: unstated

name: doc-style 2 banned prose shapes
does: Never write consequence chains, failure stories, alternatives not taken, arguments, repeated context
preventsClaim: AI-slop narrative padding in comments

name: doc-style 3 plain words no metaphor
does: Bans metaphors such as money rides X or the whole point
preventsClaim: unstated

name: doc-style 4 define module jargon
does: Define in 2-4 plain words on first use, or replace
preventsClaim: unstated

name: doc-style 5 vocabulary verbs in prose
does: Prose about our operations uses the naming.md verb, never a synonym
preventsClaim: two words for one operation
costNote: per prose pass; naming.md is a separate 148-line read

name: doc-style 6 shorten with a floor
does: Every non-obvious constraint survives as one plain sentence; the cold reader can still tell what it is for
preventsClaim: shortening deletes the only statement of a constraint

name: doc-style 6a no colons or em-dashes
does: Bans colons, semicolons, em-dashes and vertical slashes in comment and doc prose
preventsClaim: the punctuation tell of AI-written prose

name: doc-style 6b describe what exists
does: No moved, renamed, extracted, now, the caller did, or task numbers
preventsClaim: a comment is read by someone who never saw the diff

name: Comments heading
does: Heading only
preventsClaim: unstated

name: doc-style 7 delete name-derivable comments
does: Delete any comment the reader could write from the name alone
preventsClaim: comments that restate the code

name: doc-style 8 do not restate the type
does: Never restate what the type documents or what a TypeScript construct enforces
preventsClaim: comments that restate the declaration

name: doc-style 9 grounding lines only when needed
does: Skip a grounding line when the name already places the export
preventsClaim: unstated

name: doc-style 10 every fact at its level
does: Field facts on the field, production facts in the producer, consumer usage in the consumer, absences nowhere
preventsClaim: a fact repeated at two levels, or consumer usage recorded in the export

name: doc-style 11 headers optional
does: One grounding sentence plus at most one contract fact when present
preventsClaim: unstated

name: doc-style 12 hard length caps
does: JSDoc under 3 sentences, inline under 2 lines; never name or link doc files in comments
preventsClaim: verbose comments; overflow belongs in the design doc

name: doc-style 13 field one-liners are noun phrases
does: Earliest spend entry (YYYY-MM-DD), not a sentence
preventsClaim: unstated

name: doc-style 14 every enum member documented
does: Each enum member and public API prop gets one telegraphic description, even a restating one
preventsClaim: a mixed column scans slower than a complete one

name: doc-style 15 Verify comments are terse lists
does: Load-bearing fields and behaviors only, no narrative
preventsClaim: unstated

name: doc-style 16-17 doc prose rules
does: Lead with the fact; short declarative sentences, no fragments, no suspense
preventsClaim: unstated

name: No churn and exemplars
does: Compliant text stays byte-identical; two named exemplar files set the register
preventsClaim: a style pass rewrites compliant text on marginal preference
costNote: per prose pass; reading the two exemplars is extra

name: doc-style rewrite pass procedure
does: List changed files, read every new comment and doc paragraph, fix rule breaks, skip untouched text
preventsClaim: prose ships unreviewed against these rules
costNote: one full re-read of every changed prose line before reporting done

name: ui-conventions frontmatter
does: Declares the skill name
preventsClaim: unstated

name: ui-conventions trigger description
does: Read BEFORE writing or editing any Vue component or page in hosting/
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Strict preset, never guess a class
does: Only listed tokens exist; arbitrary values blocked; unknown classes silently generate no CSS
preventsClaim: a guessed Tailwind class produces nothing and the bug is invisible

name: Spacing scale table
does: Token to px mapping; p-5 is 24px and p-6 is 48px, not Tailwind's values
preventsClaim: Tailwind muscle memory picks the wrong spacing step

name: Never derive spacing from main.css
does: Measure the computed value in the browser before picking a negative-margin step
preventsClaim: the unlayered UnoCSS reset wins over main.css, so its declarations mislead
costNote: a browser measurement per spacing decision

name: Typography scale and atoms
does: text-0..8 and font-1/2/3 only; prefer H1/H2/H3, P, SmallText, Strong atoms
preventsClaim: there is no font-medium or font-semibold

name: Emphasize with Strong not quotes
does: Never use guillemets or quote characters for emphasis
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Color token scale
does: brand-primary, neutral-1..7, status-*, transparent variants, data-1..8 for charts only; no white/black/gray
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Use existing shortcuts not rebuilds
does: btn, text-input, content, rounded, top-bar and the rest already exist; prefer the atoms
preventsClaim: rebuilding a shortcut that already exists

name: Disabled opacity inherits
does: Put disabled on each inert element, never on a row holding a working control
preventsClaim: dimming a working control reads as disabled

name: row-divider is the shared divider
does: Never re-implement the stacked-list divider with scoped :not(:last-of-type) CSS
preventsClaim: a duplicated divider implementation

name: Component idiom to imitate
does: Match ScheduleRuleRow.vue; scoped style only for what UnoCSS cannot express
preventsClaim: scoped CSS written for a need a standard utility already covers
costNote: per UI task; reading the exemplar is extra

name: Shorthand prop binding
does: Bind a same-named ref with the shorthand; never mix the two forms on one tag
preventsClaim: mixing is the tell that a binding was written without looking at siblings

name: Dialog secondary action is a Button
does: Never TextButton beside outlined buttons; danger reserved for destructive
preventsClaim: a text link reads as a different class of control and misses the 44px tap target

name: Forms go through useForm
does: Never hand-rolled refs; extract an organisms/XxxForm that owns useForm and emits typed submit
preventsClaim: an emit cannot be awaited, so the parent must track completion

name: Atom molecule organism layering
does: Every component sits in one of three layers, never a feature-named folder
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Pages stay thin
does: Coordination lives in a page composable, shared state in Pinia stores
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Exemplar table, imitate the closest
does: Nine building blocks mapped to the component whose idiom to copy
preventsClaim: designing a component from scratch

name: Dialog title goes in the title prop
does: Never an H1 first in the body; never hand-roll dialog chrome
preventsClaim: the dialog renders a 60px empty header band and the title lands ~84px down

name: Also remember block restates CLAUDE.md
does: Repeats UX prefix, scdate comparison, single root, formatDemoName, Spanish Word Choices
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: per UI task; duplicates hosting/CLAUDE.md lines 25-31 and 45-48

name: Run ui-verify after it builds
does: Chains into the ui-verify skill
preventsClaim: unstated

name: ui-verify frontmatter and tools
does: Declares the skill name
preventsClaim: unstated

name: ui-verify trigger description
does: Run after ANY change to hosting components, pages or layouts, before reporting done; names the three subagents and their models
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: in every agent's skill listing; ~90 words

name: Never report UI done on typecheck
does: Render it, look at it, poke the changed states; run autonomously without asking the user
preventsClaim: build-tsc misses .vue template errors

name: Orchestrator never reads a screenshot
does: Screenshots pass by file path; only reviewer subagents Read them
preventsClaim: images are re-tokenized into the main context every turn
costNote: the central cost-control rule of the skill

name: Stack-up check
does: tmux check for 5 named windows, else invoke dev-up
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: one tmux call, plus dev-up when down

name: Foreign stack check and human stop
does: Compare the firebase pane's path to the repo root; stop and ask before taking over
preventsClaim: screenshotting another worktree's code
costNote: blocks the run until the user answers

name: Readiness markers and stale dist
does: Check pane markers; rebuild functions after backend edits since the emulator has no watcher
preventsClaim: stale dist surfaces as callable 400s or an emulator that will not start
costNote: a yarn build when the backend changed

name: Decide URLs, states and goal first
does: Work out target URLs, reference sibling URL, states to exercise and a one-line user goal before spawning
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Seeded entity ids and route builders
does: Emulator Tacos ids; click through the UI rather than guessing unknown ids; verify shared components on their pages
preventsClaim: guessing entity ids

name: Pick the reference sibling screen
does: Choose the closest existing screen and capture it too
preventsClaim: the design pass has nothing to compare against

name: Browser subagent runs on haiku
does: Spawn the Playwright driver with model haiku; one exception for fast-dismissing states
preventsClaim: browser driving generates the most tokens

name: Login only if bounced
does: Navigate to the target first; log in only on a bounce; surface-to-account table
preventsClaim: a re-spawned subagent pays for a login it inherits

name: Browser subagent prompt contents
does: Hand it target URLs, reference URL, states, screenshot directory, known deep links
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Resize mobile-first 375x812
does: Phone viewport first, 1280x800 additionally for staff and admin pages
preventsClaim: this is a phone-first PWA

name: Exercise the changed states
does: Open dialogs, toggle, type, submit, trigger empty and error states; undo anything changed
preventsClaim: a first-paint screenshot verifies nothing about a state the change added
costNote: one interaction sequence per changed state

name: Read console and note error overlay
does: browser_console_messages at warning level; flag a full-screen Nuxt error overlay
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Screenshots to disk, boxes stay transient
does: Capture target and reference; take the boxes snapshot but never Write it to disk
preventsClaim: box data persisted would be re-tokenized later
costNote: 2+ screenshots and 2 boxes snapshots per round

name: Six box-arithmetic checks
does: Overflow past 375px, tap targets under 44px, equal sibling heights, left-edge alignment, group gap ordering, spacing scale
preventsClaim: visual inconsistency the eye misses
costNote: computed per captured viewport by the haiku subagent

name: Browser subagent return contract
does: Return only verdict, flags, sibling/group sets, console findings, exercised states, reload result, paths, deep links
preventsClaim: a11y snapshots, boxes and image bytes crossing back get re-tokenized every turn
costNote: caps what enters the main context

name: Order-terminal click blockers
does: Dismiss the Toca para iniciar screen and the alertdialog; resolve elements from the snapshot not memory
preventsClaim: the alertdialog is not in the a11y tree

name: Escalate the browser subagent to sonnet
does: Re-spawn with model sonnet when flags look unreliable or a state came back unexercised
preventsClaim: a cheap model's wrong grouping makes flags falsely clean

name: Design-pass reviewer subagent
does: Session-model subagent Reads the screenshots and judges visual consistency without recomputing pixel math
preventsClaim: a mis-grouping hides behind clean flags

name: Design-pass checks
does: Reference comparison, five-question heuristic checklist, Spanish copy check, tag findings change or pre-existing
preventsClaim: a screen that does not belong to the same app

name: Fresh-eyes reviewer stays blind
does: Separate session-model subagent gets only screenshot paths and a one-line goal; every confusion is a finding
preventsClaim: anyone who knows the labels cannot judge comprehensibility

name: Fix then re-verify loop
does: Re-spawn the browser subagent per fix, loop only on change findings, quote anything left unfixed
preventsClaim: a finding is closed by reasoning that the task prescribed the markup or a reviewer called it a nit
costNote: the whole 3-subagent set re-spawns per fix round

name: Final real Nuxt build
does: Run yarn build from hosting/ once clean
preventsClaim: build-tsc typechecks .vue through shims, so template errors only surface in the real build
costNote: one full Nuxt build per UI task

name: Final report contents
does: State what was verified, reference screenshots by path, quote anything left unresolved, say so if verification was impossible
preventsClaim: implying the UI was seen when it was not

name: ui-verify gotchas
does: Absolute screenshot paths, stale-connection recovery, vite dep cache after upgrades, restore seeded entities, pin the emulator project id
preventsClaim: a wrong project id silently hits an empty namespace and still reports success

name: ui-verify README not loaded at runtime
does: States the file is maintainer documentation, never loaded when the skill runs
preventsClaim: rationale bloats the file loaded on every invocation

name: Why verbose bytes go in subagents
does: Explains re-tokenization cost and the discarded subagent transcript
preventsClaim: main-transcript bytes are re-billed every subsequent turn

name: Four-actor table
does: Main agent, haiku browser subagent, two session-model reviewers and what each owns
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Why haiku drives the browser
does: Browser driving is mechanical and generates the most tokens; reviewers inherit the session model
preventsClaim: a hardcoded model name to keep in sync

name: Why box math lives with the driver
does: Arithmetic is objective and compresses to flags; grouping is not, so two mitigations exist
preventsClaim: a cheap model's wrong grouping makes flags falsely clean

name: Why the two reviewers are separate
does: There is no way to un-tell a model something inside one context
preventsClaim: a reviewer that knows the feature cannot be surprised

name: Why the fix loop re-spawns
does: Continuing keeps the verbose transcript alive and re-bills it every turn
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Why the sonnet escape hatch exists
does: The failure mode of too cheap is visible and recoverable, not a silent wrong answer
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Single shared browser consequences
does: Subagents run sequentially, auth carries over, browsing mutates shared emulator data
preventsClaim: two browser subagents would fight over the same tab
